summary: test check failed (exit 1): TestCLISignalsStopPollDescendants/poll/SIGINT and poll/SIGTERM timed out waiting for child-pid. Root cause is the inherited Powder environment (POWDER_AGENT=forest-iron-forest and POWDER_API_BASE_URL set) leaking into go test; the unchanged poll test assumes POWDER_AGENT is unset, so reconcilePowderPrimary proceeds past its early return and errors during git ls-remote in the non-repo fixture before the gh descendant starts. go test ./... passes with POWDER_AGENT/POWDER_API_BASE_URL/POWDER_URL unset. The diff (powder_completion.go, tests, ADR) correctly turns Powder not_found into a blocking error for builder and later approves while preserving already-landed gates; no blocking findings in the changed code. Revision can fast-forward master.
